buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Supply (Bid price to include all cost components):- Supply of Goods as per Terms & Condition s / Monitoring Instruction enclosed in bid. 2. Bidder must submit Monitoring Instruction duly signed & stamped fo r acceptance along with their offer,failing which offer may be rejected. 2.1. PV CLAUSE: Price variation clause is applicable as follows: P = Po + 0.9 (N2 – N1) ……………..(i) Where, P = Final Basic rate at which the payment will be made to the firm for the receipts. Po = Basic quoted rate in the tender during bid submission in INR including all but ex cluding GST. N2 = Price of base oil(N32/N100/N460)on the 1st day of supplying month. N1 = Price of base oil( N32/N100/N460) on the 1st day of month of Bid End date. 0.9 is the factor taken in PVC formula for taking weight age of Base Oil. As normally a lubricant contains about 90% base oil and rest are addictive. Firm should submit the Base oil prices issued by any central govt. firm/Central PSU, applicable on the 1 s t day of month of Bid End date, along with their bid. Po (Basic quoted price) will remain constant throughout the execution period of the contract Note:The firm will provide Base oil prices issued by any central govt. firm/Central PSU, applicable on the 1st day of month on the date of actual delivery during the entire contract period if the supply order is concl uded on their firm. 3 The bidder should have average annual turnover of ₹ 1 lakhs during the financial year 20 23-24, 2024-2025 and 2025-26. Bidders has to submit CA certified turnover details for the financial year 2 023-24, 2024-2 025 and 2025-26. 4. MSEs and Startup firms are exempted from experience and turnover criteria. As per the latest order issu ed by Ministry of MSME, if a bidder is a Micro or small Enterprise(MSE) thenthe bidder shall be relaxed fro m experience criteria & bidder turnover subject to meeting of quality and technical specification. NOTE- The bidder seeking relaxation for experience criteria & bidder turnover shall uploadthe supporting d ocuments to p rove his eligibility criteria for relaxation.The firm should submit the following documents alo ng with the bid for evaluation:

i.Documents in support of Experience Criteria. ii.Documents in support of Bidder Annual Turnover. 5. 25% Option Clause = 25% option clause shall be applicable. 6. Firm should submit copy of GSTIN & PAN Card. 7Commercial Experience Eligibility Criteria - The bidder should be registered & established for the supply of relevant category (SERVOSYSTEM HLP-46 / SERVO OILS/LUBRICATING OIL HYDRAULIC OIL) in Ordnance Factory Ambarnath or other ordnance Factorie s. (OR) The bidder should be supplier of relevant category (SERVOSYSTEM HLP-46 /SERVO OILS/LUBRICATING OIL HYDRAULIC OIL ) in ordnance factory Ambernath /sister ordnance factories/ state Govt./Central Govt. Orga nization/ PSU/Public listed firms/ Reputed private firms during the last 07 years ending on last day of mont h in which last date of submission falls and submitted supply order copy as follows I. Three orders each executed for supply of relevant category (SERVOSYSTEM HLP-46 /SERVO OILS/LUBRIC ATING OIL HYDRAULIC OIL ) where executed value is not less than the amount equal to ₹ 59472.00 (OR) II. Two orders each executed for supply of similar item (SERVOSYSTEM HLP-46 /SERVO OILS/LUBRICATING OIL HYDRAULIC OIL ) )where execute d value is not less than the amount equal to 79296.00 (OR) III. One order executed for supply of similar item ( SERVOSYSTEM HLP-46 /SERVO OILS/LUBRICATING OIL H YDRAULIC OIL ) where executed value is not less than the amount equal to ₹ 138768.00 8.Bidder Turn over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last th ree years, ending on 31st march of the previous financial year,should be as indicated in the bid document . Documentary evidence in the form of certificate audited balance sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the charted accountant / cost accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period s h all be uploaded with the bid. In case of the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 y ears old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial year after the date of constitution shall be taken into the account for these criteria. 9.Payment Terms – As per Terms & Conditions / Monitoring Instruction enclosed in bid payment is to be ma de within 45 days of receipt and acceptance of materials at the factory premises along with requisite/relev ant documents from suppliers.Payment will be made Monthly basis on submission of Invoice supported by job completion certificate as per Monitoring Instruction s . 10) There can be occasions when excess/short supplies are made by the suppliers due to various reasons. These variations in supplies may be accepted with the approvalof CFA, subject to the value of such excess / short supplies not exceeding 5% (five percent) of the original value of the contract. 11) Supply orders where the GST amount shall exceed ₹ 5,000.00/- The invoices should be uploaded imme diately by the supplier in GSTR-1/FF so that the invoice appears in GSTR-2B of the branches. If not found in GSTR-2B of the branches. Payment should be withheld unless it appears in the GSTR2B of the branches. 12) All successful bidders must ensure that every service rendered or product supplied under the contract is supported by a mandatory e-invoice as per prevailing GST regulations. Jcc for the service and IGP for the products are contingent upon the verification of said e-invoice. The purchaser reserves the right to refuse any services lacking proper e-invoice documentation at the supplier’s risk and cost. 13) In case of any query, feel free to contact Shri Pramod Patil, Assistant works Manager.
